blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Hierarchical world models plan over long horizons by passing predicted states from a coarse model to a lower-level controller. Choosing these states can be expensive: the upper-level planner repeatedly differentiates through candidate macro-action trajectories. We replace this search with a lightweight goal-conditioned network trained through the frozen high-level predictor. The network supplies a conditioning vector, while the predictor generates the next latent waypoint. Training uses hindsight goals and state-prediction losses on offline trajectories, without search-solution targets or macro-action labels. Inference retains an autoregressive high-level rollout, but requires no high-level candidate optimization. We evaluate this approach on the shared-latent HWM checkpoints distributed with H-JEPA, using three backbone seeds and three head initializations per backbone. With a common evaluation protocol, mean success is 70.4% on Cube, 48.7% on Push-T, 100.0% on FourRoom, and 71.1% on Visual AntMaze. The method improves over the corresponding HWM search baseline on three environments and has the same mean on Push-T. Dedicated measurements on an NVIDIA L40S give 1.28-4.39x end-to-end speedups for batched evaluation. Ablations identify state-adaptive conditioning as a consistent contributor, while predictor-mediated subgoals and unrestricted conditions have environment-dependent benefits.
blocks.zh: 分级世界模型通过从粗细模型到下级控制器的预测状态,在长的地平线上进行计划. 选择这些状态可能很昂贵:高层规划者通过候选宏观动作轨迹反复区分. 我们用一个轻量级的入门条件网络来取代这次搜索 通过被冻结的高水平预测器训练 网络提供调制向量,而预测器则产生下个潜在的路由点. 训练在下线轨迹上使用后视目标及状态预测损失,没有搜索-解决目标或宏观行动标签. 推论保留了自发性高层次推出,但不需要高层次候选人优化. 我们在与H-JEPA分配的共用直线HWM检查站上评价这一办法,每个主干线使用3个主干种子和3个头部初始化. 有共同的评价协议,Cube上的平均成功率为70.4%,Push-T上为48.7%,FourRoom上为100.0%,Visual AntMaze上为71.1%. 该方法比对应的HWM在三种环境中的搜索基线有所改进,在Push-T上也有相同的平均值. NVIDIA L40S上的专用测量给出了1.28-4.39x端到端的速率来进行分批评价. 赤字将国家适应性条件确定为一贯的促进因素,而预测介导的次级目标和不受限制的条件则具有取决于环境的利益。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Visual world models support control by predicting the consequences of actions in a compact latent space [ 14 , 17 , 20 , 40 , 24 ] . Long-horizon planning remains difficult because the action search grows with temporal depth and prediction errors accumulate. Hierarchical models address this challenge by decomposing control across temporal scales: a coarse model predicts latent waypoints that a finer planner tries to reach. HWM [ 39 ] uses a shared latent space across levels, while H-JEPA [ 38 ] learns a separate representation at each level.
blocks.zh: 视觉世界模型通过预测在紧凑的潜在空间中采取行动的后果支持控制[14、17、20、40、24]。 长视距规划仍然很困难,因为动作搜索随着时间深度和预测错误的积累而增加. 分级模型通过分解跨时间尺度的控制来应对这一挑战:粗糙模型预测一个更精细的规划者试图达到的潜在方向. HWM[39]使用一个跨级别共享的潜在空间,而H-JEPA[38]则在每一级别学习单独的代表.

blocks.en: Choosing the high-level plan can itself be expensive. The planner optimizes candidate macro-action sequences by repeatedly rolling out and differentiating through the coarse predictor. The released two-level configurations permit up to 9,000–72,000 candidate-trajectory updates per decision. Although early stopping reduces this budget, high-level optimization accounts for a large fraction of evaluation time in the measured settings.
blocks.zh: 选择高级计划本身可能很昂贵. 规划者通过粗细的预测器反复推出和区分来优化候选宏观动作序列. 公布的两级配置允许每个决定最多9 000至72,000名候选人-预测更新。 虽然提前停止会减少这一预算,但高水平优化在所计量的环境下占评价时间的很大一部分.

blocks.en: We propose to learn the inputs to this frozen predictor. Its conditioning interface provides a useful point of intervention: a small network maps a latent state, a goal, and a remaining-step input to a condition, and the coarse model turns that condition into the next waypoint. Figure 1 shows the resulting hierarchy. The encoder and both predictive models stay frozen, and the low level retains its action optimizer. The learned head removes upper-level candidate optimization while preserving autoregressive prediction through the world model.
blocks.zh: 我们建议学习这个冷冻预测器的输入。 它的调制接口提供了一个有用的干预点:一个小的网络映射一个潜伏状态,一个目标,以及一个条件的剩余步骤输入,粗糙的模型将这个条件变成下一个方向. 图1显示了由此产生的等级。 编码器和两种预测模型都保持冻结,低水平保留其动作优化器. 博学的头部在保留通过世界模型进行自递性预测的同时,取消了高层候选人优化.

blocks.en: The head learns from offline trajectories using their endpoints as hindsight goals. Teacher-forced prediction provides local transition supervision, autoregressive rollout loss trains on generated contexts, and an endpoint term emphasizes arrival at the goal. Gradients pass through the frozen predictor to update the head. This objective uses observed state sequences, without macro-action labels or search-solution targets. It consequently learns a goal-conditioned controller through the model rather than distilling a particular search algorithm.
blocks.zh: 头部使用其端点作为后视目标从离线轨迹中学习. 教师强制预测提供当地过渡监督,在生成的环境下自动推出损失列车,一个终点期强调到达目标. 渐变通过冰冻的预测器来更新头部. 这个目标使用观测到的状态序列,没有宏观动作标签或搜索解决目标. 因此,它通过模型学习一个有目标条件的控制器,而不是蒸馏一个特定的搜索算法.

blocks.en: We evaluate on the shared-latent HWM checkpoints distributed with H-JEPA, with three backbone seeds and three head initializations per backbone. Relative to HWM search with the same low-level objective, mean success increases from 51.3% to 70.4% on Cube, 72.0% to 100.0% on FourRoom, and 35.3% to 71.1% on Visual AntMaze; Push-T has the same mean, 48.7%. Dedicated NVIDIA L40S measurements give 1.28 1.28 – 4.39 × 4.39\times end-to-end speedups for batched evaluation. Ablations show that state-adaptive conditioning consistently helps, while the benefit of routing subgoals through the predictor or restricting conditions to macro-action embeddings depends on the environment.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A lightweight goal-conditioned head that replaces high-level macro-action optimization by learning predictor conditions through a frozen hierarchical world model. • An evaluation across four visual-control environments, three backbones, and three heads per backbone, with a common success protocol and separate measurements of online and training cost. • Controlled ablations of predictor-mediated subgoals, condition dimensionality, head inputs, and training losses that identify the design choices supported by these experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: • 一个轻量级的、有目标条件的头,通过一个冻结的等级世界模型来学习预测器的条件,取代高层次的宏观行动优化。 评估跨越4个视觉控制环境,3个骨干,每个骨干3个头,共同成功协议,并分别测量在线和培训成本. · 控制预测媒介的次级目标、条件维度、头部投入和培训损失,以确定这些试验所支持的设计选择。

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: World Models [ 14 ] , PlaNet [ 17 ] , Dreamer [ 16 , 18 , 19 ] , and TD-MPC [ 20 , 21 ] demonstrate predictive control and policy learning in latent spaces. DINO-WM [ 40 ] and LeWM [ 24 ] plan with visual representations without requiring pixel reconstruction for control. For navigation, Bar et al. [ 7 ] plan with action-conditioned video predictions. JEPA [ 22 ] motivates prediction in representation space; I-JEPA and V-JEPA [ 4 , 8 , 5 ] develop this approach for images and video. HWM [ 39 ] shares a latent space across temporal scales, while H-JEPA [ 38 ] learns an abstraction at each level. We operate on the former architecture, using the latter project’s released models and tasks.
blocks.zh: World Models [14], PlaNet [17], Dreamer [16, 18, 19], 和TD-MPC [20, 21] 演示了在潜在空间中的预测控制和政策学习. DINO-WM[40]和LEWM[24]计划带有视觉表现而不需要像素重建来控制. 用于导航,Bar等人. [7]计划 附带行动条件的视频预测。 JEPA[22]鼓励在表示空间进行预测;I-JEPA和V-JEPA[4,8,5]为图像和视频开发这种方法. HWM[39]在时间尺度上共享潜在的空间,而H-JEPA[38]则在每个层次学习抽象. 我们在前一个架构上运作,使用后一个项目的释放模型和任务.

blocks.en: Sampling and gradient-based planners optimize action sequences through learned dynamics. Examples include CEM [ 32 , 11 ] , PETS [ 10 ] , PDDM [ 26 ] , iCEM [ 31 ] , MPPI [ 37 ] , and differentiable MPC [ 1 ] . Rather than improving the optimizer, we replace the upper-level optimization with learned conditional inference. We retain the lower-level optimizer and therefore do not remove all test-time search.
blocks.zh: 取样和基于梯度的规划者通过学习的动态优化动作序列. 例如CEM [32,11],PETS [10],PDM [26],iCEM [31],MPPI [37],以及不同的MPC [1]. 与其改进优化器,不如用学到的有条件推论取代上层优化. 我们保留了低级优化器,因此不删除所有测试时间搜索.

blocks.en: Options [ 35 , 6 ] , FeUdal Networks [ 36 ] , HIRO [ 25 ] , HAC [ 23 ] , and Director [ 15 ] use temporal abstraction in reinforcement learning. Hindsight goal relabeling [ 3 ] , visual goal representations [ 27 ] , goal-conditioned supervised learning [ 13 ] , and offline goal-conditioned methods [ 12 , 30 ] provide ways to learn conditional controllers. Our head similarly learns from hindsight goals, but its output conditions a frozen coarse predictor rather than directly specifying a primitive action or an unconstrained subgoal.
blocks.zh: 选项 [35, 6], Feudal Networks [36], HIRO [25], HAC [23], 主任 [15] 在强化学习中使用时间抽象. 后视目标重新标注[3],视觉目标表现[27],目标条件监督学习[13],离线目标条件方法[12,30]提供了学习条件控制器的方法. 我们的头同样从后视目标中吸取教训,但是它的输出条件是一个冷冻的粗糙的预测器,而不是直接指定一个原始行动或不受约束的次级目标.

blocks.en: Amortized optimization learns a map that avoids repeatedly solving related optimization problems [ 2 ] . Search-supervised systems such as AlphaZero and MuZero [ 34 , 33 ] explicitly learn from solver outputs. Our training targets are observed latent states, not optimized plans. Closest to our setting, Nguyen et al. [ 28 ] learn goal-conditioned latent inverse dynamics to replace planning in a flat world model. We instead learn conditions for a coarse predictor within a two-level controller, while keeping primitive-action planning. The two interfaces could be combined to learn conditions at the high level and actions at the low level.
blocks.zh: 摊销优化学习地图 避免反复解决相关优化问题[2]. AlphaZero和MuZero等搜索监督系统[34,33]明确学习解析器输出. 我们的训练目标被观察到潜在的状态,而不是优化的计划。 最接近我们的环境,阮等. [28] 学习以目标为条件的潜在反向动态,以平坦的世界模式取代规划. 相反,我们在两级控制器内学习粗糙预测器的条件,同时保持原始的行动规划. 这两个接口可以合并,以学习高层次的条件和低层次的行动。

blocks.en: 4.1. Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 4.1. 评价程序

blocks.en: We use the four fixed 50-task sets distributed with H-JEPA: Cube from OGBench [ 29 ] , Push-T [ 9 ] , FourRoom Distractors, and Visual AntMaze. Episode budgets are 30, 90, 210, and 350 environment steps, respectively. We use HWM backbone seeds 42, 43, and 44, with head initializations 0, 1, and 2 for each backbone. AntMaze embeddings use the same proprioceptive normalization during training and control. FourRoom head checkpoints are selected on a separately collected validation set of 150 trajectories. Data and selection details are provided in the supplement.
blocks.zh: 我们使用与H-JEPA分配的四套固定50个任务: 来自OGBench的立方体 [29], Push-T [9],四室干扰器,和视觉AntMaze. 集成预算分别为30,90,210,350个环境步骤. 我们使用HWM骨干种子42,43和44,每个骨干头初始化0,1和2. AntMaze嵌入在训练和控制过程中使用相同的自主正常化. 四室头检查站选用单独收集的150个轨迹的验证组. 资料和选择细节见补编。

blocks.en: The optimizer and head architecture are shared across environments: AdamW, learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , cosine decay, 20,000 updates, batch size 256, and gradient clipping at 1.0. Segment transition counts K K are 2, 8, 12, and 9 for Cube, Push-T, FourRoom, and AntMaze. These equal the initial high-level planning horizons; we assess sensitivity to training length in Sec. 4.4 . We select the minimum endpoint MAE on the same 256 validation windows, evaluated every 2,000 updates. Task success is not used to select head checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 优化器和头部架构在环境上是共享的: AdamW,学习率 10 - 3 10 - Q-3}, 余弦衰变, 20,000更新, 批量大小 256, 梯度剪切 1.0. 分段过渡计数K为2,8,12,Cube,Push-T,Four Room,和AntMaze为9. 这相当于最初的高级别规划范围;我们在4.4中评估对培训时间的敏感性。 我们在同一256个验证窗口上选择最小端点MAE,每2000个更新一次评价. 任务成功不用于选择检查站长 。

blocks.en: HWM search uses the identical frozen backbone as our head. H-JEPA search and the flat model use their separately trained checkpoints at the same model seeds. A simple baseline supplies equally spaced latent waypoints between the observed state and goal, retaining the same low-level controller. All success-rate experiments use the same tasks, budgets, and evaluation chunk size of one. The low-level macro-action matching coefficient is zero for both hierarchical search baselines and our method. Other optimizer settings retain the released values. Search budgets use the released defaults in Table 1 .

Some environment reset randomness is not fixed by the task assets, so run variability includes more than head initialization. Error bars describe this replication design, not uncertainty over a newly sampled population of tasks.

blocks.en: 4.2. Task success
blocks.zh: 4.2. 任务的成功

blocks.en: Table 2 reports the final results. Mean success improves over HWM search from 51.3% to 70.4% on Cube, from 72.0% to 100.0% on FourRoom, and from 35.3% to 71.1% on AntMaze. Push-T has the same mean, 48.7%, for HWM search and learned conditions. These comparisons support replacing the fixed HWM upper-level search on these benchmarks; they do not establish dominance over all possible search settings.
blocks.zh: 表2报告了最后结果。 在Cube上,HWM搜索的平均成功率从51.3%提高到70.4%,在四室上从72.0%提高到100.0%,在AntMaze上从35.3%提高到71.1%。 Push-T的平均值为48.7%,用于HWM搜索和学习条件. 这些比较支持取代了固定的HWM高层对这些基准的搜索;它们并不确立对所有可能搜索设置的主导地位.

blocks.en: The separately trained H-JEPA baseline reaches 46.7%, 40.7%, 78.7%, and 37.3% on Cube, Push-T, FourRoom, and AntMaze under this protocol. Flat planning is lower on all four task sets. This is consistent with useful temporal decomposition in these tasks, although the flat and hierarchical models differ in training as well as control. Linear latent interpolation performs poorly: 4.7% on Cube, 1.3% on Push-T, and 0% on both navigation environments. Thus the learned results are not explained by simply placing equally spaced subgoals on the straight line to the goal.
blocks.zh: 根据该议定书,单独培训的H-JEPA基线达到46.7%、40.7%、78.7%和Cube、Push-T、FourRoom和AntMaze37.3%。 平面规划在所有四套任务中都较低. 这与这些任务中有用的时间分解是一致的,尽管在培训和控制方面,统一和等级模式各不相同。 线性潜在插值性能不佳:立方体4.7%,Push-T1.3%,两个导航环境均为0%. 因此,不能简单地将同等空间的次级目标放在目标直线上来解释所吸取的经验教训。

blocks.en: 4.3. Online and training cost
blocks.zh: 4.3. 在线和培训费用

blocks.en: We measure the preselected backbone-42/head-0 model and its HWM search baseline on dedicated NVIDIA L40S allocations, with synchronized solver instrumentation. Timing uses one parallel batch of 50 environments rather than the chunk-one protocol used to compare success. It estimates batched evaluation cost, not single-task or real-time action latency. For Cube and Push-T, the timing baseline retains the released action-matching coefficient 0.2, whereas the head uses zero; these are the timing configurations rather than a strict isolation of the high-level component.
blocks.zh: 我们在专用的NVIDIA L40S分配上测量预选的主干-42/head-0模型及其HWM搜索基线,并配有同步的解析器仪器. 计时使用一个平行批次的50个环境,而不是用来比较成功的块一协议. 它估计的是分批评价费用,而不是单项任务或实时行动延迟。 对于Cube和Push-T,计时基准保留了释放的动作比对系数0.2,而头部使用0;这些是计时配置,而不是严格隔离高级组件.

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows end-to-end speedups of 1.28 × 1.28\times on Cube, 3.42 × 3.42\times on Push-T, 4.39 × 4.39\times on FourRoom, and 3.41 × 3.41\times on AntMaze. The high-level solver totals decrease from 26.2–1963.9 seconds per evaluation batch to 0.068–0.661 seconds. The low level remains the principal cost for the learned planner. Its elapsed time can also change because different subgoals alter predicted trajectories and data-dependent early stopping.

On AntMaze, using F 2 F_{2} increases the mean from 59.3% to 70.7% in this fixed-backbone comparison. We therefore find an environment-dependent benefit, rather than evidence that direct regression must fail or that predictor outputs are guaranteed reachable.

The head needs to adapt its condition to the current state in these experiments. However, the frozen predictor still reads states; the masked variant is not a wholly open-loop controller.
blocks.zh: 掩盖头部的状态投入意味着在立方体上的成功率从68.7%降至52.0%,在Push-T上的成功率从44.0%降至0.7%,在Four Room上的成功率从100.0%降至6.7%,在AntMaze上的成功率从70.7%降至2.0%。 头部需要适应这些实验中的现状. 然而,被冻结的预测器仍然读作状态;被遮盖的变体并不是一个完全开闭的控制器.

blocks.en: We train a head that outputs a four-dimensional macro-action, then apply the frozen lift A A before F 2 F_{2} . This constrained head reaches 73.3% on Cube and 70.7% on AntMaze, compared with 68.7% and 70.7% for unrestricted conditions. Push-T is 40.7% versus 44.0%. These results do not support a universal need to leave the macro-action embedding. The final AntMaze head does depart from the leading four-dimensional subspace obtained by principal component analysis (PCA) of action-derived conditions, but such departure is a descriptive diagnostic, not a nonlinear-manifold membership test or an explanation of the success improvement.
blocks.zh: 我们训练一个能输出四维宏观动作的主管,然后在F 2 F_{2}前应用冷冻升降机A. 这种受限头部在立方体上达到73.3%,在AntMaze上达到70.7%,而在无限制条件下则为68.7%和70.7%。 Push-T为40.7%对44.0%. 这些结果并不支持将宏观行动置之不理的普遍需要。 最终的AntMaze头的确偏离了主要元件分析(PCA)对动作衍生条件获得的领先四维子空间,但这种偏离是一种描述性的诊断,而不是非线性-狂性成员测试或对成功改进的解释.

blocks.en: The full loss sweep on Cube and Push-T is reported in the supplement. Removing individual terms does not consistently hurt Cube; on Push-T, removing ℒ ro \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ro}} decreases the mean from 44.0% to 33.3%, while teacher forcing alone reaches 31.3%. Removing ℒ end \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{end}} only removes the extra endpoint weight, since Eq. 7 still supervises the final state. The shared three-term objective is therefore a practical default, with no evidence that each term is necessary in every environment. Predicting action-derived condition labels matches the full method on Cube and is worse on Push-T. Shortening training segments substantially reduces success in the measured environments, and doubling their length hurts Push-T. Segment length is a consequential environment-specific choice.

blocks.en: 5. Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.五. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: The results support learning state-adaptive conditions for a fixed predictor. Prediction-mediated subgoals help most clearly on AntMaze, whereas direct regression and four-dimensional conditions are competitive in other environments. The head and search planner also use different context lengths. These comparisons favor a practical controller replacement, but do not isolate a unique mechanism for its success. Low prediction error remains an imperfect surrogate for physical reachability, and the lower controller can still fail to reach a predicted waypoint.
blocks.zh: 结果支持学习固定预测器的适应状态条件。 预测中的次级目标对AntMaze最有帮助,而直接回归和四维条件在其他环境中具有竞争力。 头部和搜索计划员也使用不同的上下文长度. 这些比较有利于实际的控制器替换,但并不孤立其成功的独特机制. 低预测误差仍然是物理可达性的一个不完善的代位,下级控制器仍然可能无法达到预测的路标.

blocks.en: The evaluation covers four fixed task sets and three shared-latent HWM backbones per environment. Cube and Push-T tasks come from the public validation datasets also used for head selection, so the scores describe these benchmark sets rather than an untouched test population. FourRoom uses separately collected head-validation trajectories, with no exact complete state/action trajectory duplicates in training; independence of frozen-backbone selection remains unverified. Broader assessment requires independent task collections, repeated environment seeds, and evaluation on learned upper representations or other world-model families.
blocks.zh: 评价涵盖四套固定任务和每套环境的三套共用相对的HWM主干线。 Cube和Push-T任务来自同样用于头部选择的公共验证数据集,因此分数描述的是这些基准集,而不是未触及的测试群. 四号室使用单独收集的头-验证轨迹,在训练中没有精确的完整状态/动作轨迹重复;冷冻后骨选择的独立性仍未验证. 更广泛的评估需要独立的任务收集,重复的环境种子,以及对学到的上层代表或其他世界模范家庭的评价.

blocks.en: Timing covers one preselected head and backbone per environment at a batch size of 50 on an L40S. The low level remains the main cost after upper-level search is removed, and total deployment cost also includes cache preparation and head training. Hardware, batching, search budgets, and the number of subsequent decisions will determine the practical savings. Three backbone seeds and three heads per backbone also leave limited power for small architectural differences.
blocks.zh: 计时涵盖每条环境一个预选头和主干,在L40S上分批量50. 低水平仍然是取消高级搜索后的主要成本,部署总成本还包括缓存准备和头部训练. 硬件,批量,搜索预算,以及后续决定的数量,将决定实际节约. 3个骨干种子和每个骨干3个头也因小的建筑差异留下了有限的力量.

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6个 结论

blocks.en: A goal-conditioned network trained through a frozen coarse predictor can replace macro-action optimization in a hierarchical world model. Hindsight state supervision learns useful predictor inputs without search targets or macro-action labels. On the evaluated shared-latent HWM checkpoints, this improves mean task success on three of four environments, preserves the mean on Push-T, and substantially reduces batched online evaluation cost. The method retains autoregressive high-level prediction and low-level search. Its architectural advantages depend on the environment, and testing on independent tasks and learned upper representations is a necessary next step toward broader claims.
blocks.zh: 通过冷冻粗糙的预测器训练的有目标条件的网络,可以在分级世界模型中取代宏观动作优化. Hindsight状态监督在不搜索目标或宏动作标签的情况下学习有用的预测器输入. 在经过评估的共享-适切的HWM检查站,这改善了四个环境中的三个环境中的任务成功率,保持了Push-T上的平均值,并大大减少了批量在线评价费用。 该方法保留了自递式高水平预测和低水平搜索. 它的建筑优势取决于环境,对独立任务和学习的上层表述的测试是朝着更广泛的主张迈出的下一步。

blocks.en: The observation encoder combines a 256-dimensional visual embedding with a 128-dimensional proprioceptive embedding, giving latent dimension d = 384 d=384 . blocks.en: We draw 256 validation windows using NumPy random seed 7 and reuse exactly those windows at every validation check. Each run is checked every 2,000 updates through update 20,000. All variants, including short- and long-segment training, use the environment’s default validation horizon and the same windows. Test-set maxima over model seeds, head initializations, or search budgets are not used in the main comparison.

blocks.en: The released lower-level controller can match its predicted action embedding to the upper-level macro-action as an auxiliary objective. Its coefficient is 0.2 on Cube and Push-T, and zero on FourRoom and AntMaze. Our unrestricted head does not supply a native macro-action, so this term is disabled. For the main success comparison, it is also disabled in both hierarchical search baselines. This is an action-embedding matching term, not simply a penalty on primitive-action magnitude.

blocks.en: Upper search uses at most 90 AdamW updates, with candidate counts 100, 400, 800, and 200 for Cube, Push-T, FourRoom, and AntMaze. Its objective sums squared coordinate differences between the terminal predicted state and the goal; only the final state is scored at the upper level. Early stopping uses the released solver criterion. Macro-action candidates are initialized from training statistics and clipped to per-coordinate training quantiles. The search rollout uses its released one-state context, whereas learned-condition rollouts use up to three state/condition pairs. All other search hyperparameters and task budgets retain their released values. These are fixed operating points without a new independent hyperparameter sweep.

blocks.en: The direct head has the same inputs and hidden architecture as the full head, but its output is the next latent state. Teacher-forcing, rollout, and endpoint losses are computed directly on that output; F 2 F_{2} is bypassed during its state prediction. The four-dimensional variant outputs a macro-action and applies the frozen lift A A before F 2 F_{2} . Both are trained end to end with the same state losses. A restricted output is therefore a trained control variant, not a projection of the unrestricted head after training.

blocks.en: The no-state variant masks the head’s state input during teacher forcing, autoregressive training, and deployment. F 2 F_{2} still receives the true or predicted latent context. This removes a state input from the condition generator without removing all state dependence from control. The no-horizon variant sets the head’s remaining-step input to zero during both training and deployment.

In supervised-condition training, the target is A ⁡ ( 𝒂 ) A(\bm{a}) , where 𝒂 ∈ ℝ 4 \bm{a}\in\mathbb{R}^{4} is a macro-action inferred by the frozen action encoder from recorded action sequences and A A is the frozen macro-action lift. blocks.en: Reduced objectives have similar or higher means on Cube, whereas Push-T is more sensitive to rollout loss and endpoint weighting. Four-dimensional conditions are competitive on Cube and AntMaze, while removing head state inputs hurts all environments. State-adaptive conditioning consistently helps; the best output constraint and loss combination depend on the task. Three head runs leave small differences unresolved.
blocks.zh: 降低的目标在立方体上具有类似或更高的手段,而Push-T对推出损失和端点加权更为敏感. 四维条件在Cube和AntMaze上具有竞争力,同时移除头态输入会伤害所有环境. 国家适应性条件始终有帮助;最佳的产出制约和损失组合取决于任务。 三个头的运行留下了小的分歧没有解决.

blocks.en: Appendix F Dedicated evaluation timing
blocks.zh: 专门评价时间

blocks.en: Table S5 gives synchronized timing for the preselected backbone-42/head-0 model. Each pair runs on a dedicated NVIDIA L40S and evaluates 50 environments in one parallel batch, with the same task set and execution budget on the two sides. This measures batched evaluation cost separately from the chunk-one success protocol; it does not estimate sequential single-task latency.
blocks.zh: 表S5给出了预选主干-42/head-0型号的同步时间. 每对都运行在专用的NVIDIA L40S上,并在一个平行批次中评价50个环境,两侧的任务设置和执行预算相同. 这项措施将评价费用与成功协议分开进行;它没有估计连续的单一任务间隔。

blocks.en: The high and low columns accumulate synchronized solver wall time at the respective level. Total evaluation time additionally includes observation processing, simulation, and other evaluation work. Subgoal choice changes trajectories and data-dependent early stopping, so equal solver call counts can still yield different low-level times.
blocks.zh: 高低的柱子在各自的级别上累积同步解壁时间. 总评价时间还包括观察处理、模拟和其他评价工作。 次级目标选择改变轨迹和数据依赖的早期停止,因此等价的解调器调用计数仍然可以产生不同的低水平时间.

blocks.en: In the timed evaluations, both methods make four low-level calls and one high-level call on Cube, ten and seven on Push-T, twenty-two and nineteen on FourRoom, and thirty-six and thirty-one on AntMaze. A call operates on the parallel batch. The horizon schedule determines the difference between the two levels.
blocks.zh: 在定时评价中,两种方法都对Cube进行4次低调呼叫和1次高调呼叫,Push-T进行10次和7次,四室进行22次和19次,AntMaze进行36次和31次. 对平行批次进行呼叫。 地平线时间表决定了两个级别之间的差别.

blocks.en: Removing candidate optimization leaves two, eight, twelve, or nine head/predictor calls at the initial horizons, respectively. The lower planner still performs gradient-based action optimization. Speedups therefore depend on the original search budget, the low-level workload, batch size, and hardware. The reported measurements exclude cache construction from any break-even calculation.
blocks.zh: 取消候选人优化后,将两个、八个、十二个或九个头级/前级电话分别留在初始视野。 下级规划师仍然执行基于梯度的动作优化. 因此,速度取决于原始搜索预算、低水平的工作量、批量规模和硬件。 所报告的测量结果将缓存构造排除在任何折合计算之外。

blocks.en: Appendix G A linear condition-space diagnostic
blocks.zh: 附录G 线性条件空间诊断

blocks.en: For backbone 42 and head initialization 0 on normalized AntMaze, we fit principal component analysis (PCA) to 20,000 action-derived training conditions A ⁡ ( 𝒂 ) A(\bm{a}) . After centering at their mean, we retain four principal components. We calibrate projection residuals on 10,000 separate action-derived validation conditions and evaluate 4,096 learned conditions from fixed validation segments, with sampling seed 314159.
blocks.zh: 对于42号主干线和正常的AntMaze上的头部初始化 0,我们把主要组件分析(PCA)配为20,000个从行动衍生的训练条件 A +(a) A(\bm{a}). 在以他们的平均值为中心之后,我们保留了四个主要组成部分。 我们校准了10,000个单独的行动产生的验证条件的投影残留,并评估了固定验证段的4,096个学到的条件,取样种子314159。

blocks.en: The components explain 99.95% of training-condition variance. Mean Euclidean projection residual is 0.386 for action-derived validation conditions and 49.923 for learned conditions; all sampled learned conditions exceed the former distribution’s 95th percentile, 0.909. On these segments, mean one-step state MAE is 0.119 with learned conditions and 0.188 with recorded-action conditions.
blocks.zh: 这些构成部分解释了99.95%的培训条件差异。 欧几利得平均投影残留值为0.386,用于行动产生的验证条件,49.923用于学习条件;所有抽样的学习条件均超过原分布的95%,0.909。 在这些片段上,平均一步状态MAE为0.119有学习条件,0.188有记录动作条件.

blocks.en: This measures departure from a fitted affine subspace, rather than membership in the nonlinear image of A A or physical waypoint reachability. The four-dimensional head also matches unrestricted conditions in AntMaze task success. These diagnostics characterize conditioning distributions without establishing a cause of improved control or estimating task-success uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 这一措施是脱离一个装配的附属空间,而不是加入A的非线性图像或物理路标可达性。 四维头还匹配AntMaze任务成功中不受限制的条件. 这些诊断对调节分布作了定性,但没有确定改进控制或估计任务成败不确定性的原因。

blocks.en: The experiments use Python 3.11.13 and PyTorch 2.7.1 with CUDA 12.8. The model source is based on commit 840e76b5 of the H-JEPA codebase with the goal-conditioned rollout implementation accompanying the model package. Encoder embeddings, action lifts, normalizers, and predictors are fixed. Task-success runs retain the original reset semantics and per-task planner seeds, with chunk size one and the common zero matching coefficient described above.
blocks.zh: 实验使用Python 3.11.13和PyTorch 2.7.1与CUDA 12.8. 模型来源以H-JEPA编码库的840e76b5承诺为基础,与模型包配套的有目标条件的推出实施. 编码器嵌入,动作升降,正常化器,和预测器是固定的. 任务成功运行保留了原有的重置语义和每任务规划器种子,块大小为1,上面描述的共同零匹配系数.
